dataset.descriptionSemantics: Recorded parcel geography, both active and retired, with record/map add/drop/alter dates; source includes geography created since basemap inception in 1995 with exceptions. The field descriptions define the public-works mapped subset and condo grouping semantics.

query.dataMinimization: Only aggregate counts and blklot/mapblklot IDs, active/pw_recorded_map flags and geometry were requested. No owner or street/address values were queried.

semantics.blklot: Official description: unique Assessor Parcel Number, combination of Block Number and Lot Number. It uniquely identifies an assessor record, not necessarily a distinct 2D ground footprint.
semantics.mapblklot: Official description: for condominium lots that share the same 2D space, the lowest APN in the set. Strong canonical 2D-ground group key; multiple source rows can share it.
semantics.pw_recorded_map: Official description: record is part of the current Public Works basemap dataset based on recorded map information. This flag does NOT remove condominium rows that share geometry.
semantics.active: Use active=true to exclude retired parcels; the field itself has no metadata description.

proofPwRecordedMapDoesNotExcludeCondoDup.sampleGeometry: The three returned rows had identical MultiPolygon coordinates.

mapblklotWithoutMatchingBlklotRowInSubse.implication: A strict blklot=mapblklot filter removes one distinct mapblklot group in the active recorded-map subset; do not use it alone to form the complete deduplicated ground set.

recommendation: Use mapblklot as the documented 2D ground key, validate each returned geometry and collapse identical coincident rows. Retain groups without an active lowest-APN record. Stable blklot rows, counted paging and matching publication revisions are required.
description: Verified current SF ground footprints, condominium grouping and rejected identity paths.

adapterVerification.geometryConflictPolicy: Every returned row is checked; differing geometry under one mapblklot fails the whole read. No global equality claim.
adapterVerification.sourceDateInterpretation: Preserve the actual sampled row timestamps. Metadata and separately timed live queries can refer to different publication revisions.

failedAttempts.detail: Global grouped duplicate query timed out; separate non-null/distinct aggregate counts succeeded.
